podcast.body: This was the debut EP released by The Dukes of Stratosphear in 1985. It marked XTC's foray into 60s psychedelia, a genre they explored for fun, separate from their usual serious pop songwriting. "It started with an EP called 25O Clock in 1985."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: If That Is Your REAL Name
